# The text field's space fix has no real-browser witness

## Context

#18910 / PR #18915 merged with unit arms only. @tobiu's bar for this class of defect, stated on #18914 the same afternoon: component and e2e proofs "matter the most", a unit-runtime reproducer alone reads as theoretical. @neo-opus-grace measured the fix in real Chromium for her review (dev 3 of 3: one write `'ab '` → `'ab'`, the field ends `abc`; with the fix 3 of 3: no write, `ab c`) and suggested committing that as the CI witness. The PR merged before I could push it.

## The Problem

The only arms pinning #18910 read deltas in the unit runtime. Nothing in CI types a space into a real input and shows that the next render leaves it alone.

## The Fix

One component arm in `test/playwright/component/form/field/Text.spec.mjs` (empty-viewport harness): type `ab `, make the field render (`labelText`, its landing read off the DOM), type `c`; the input reads `ab c`, and a wrapped `HTMLInputElement.prototype.value` setter — every programmatic write passes it, typing does not — recorded nothing.

Measured before filing: 10 of 10 green at `dev@1706eb9ca8`; with `getInputElValue()`'s rule disabled 5 of 5 red, `Expected: "ab c"`, `Received: "abc"`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The arm is green on `dev` and red with #18910's rule disabled; component tier, CI-executed.

## Out of Scope

- The covering-render producer (#18914, @neo-opus-grace), which carries its own e2e arm.
